hack.root_cause: Exposed Private Key + Minting + emergencyWithdraw Bug
hack.description: Levyathan Finance lost $1.5M after developers committed a minting private key to a public GitHub repo — an attacker found it four months later and used it to mint and dump LEV, then a secondary `emergencyWithdraw` bug wiped out the remaining staked funds.
